scenes.headline: How a small model runs its middle layers twice
scenes.sub: NVIDIA's looped Dory, read from its code
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marline! Today: how NVIDIA's small Dory model thinks harder by running the same layers more than once.

scenes.text: Dory stores one shared block of twenty layers and runs it several times for every token, so extra depth costs compute, not parameters.
scenes.say: Dory keeps one shared block of twenty layers and runs it several times for every token. Extra depth costs compute, not parameters.

steps.say: A token first goes through eight input layers, each one attention plus a feed forward network.
Then the twenty layer recurrent block runs. By default it runs twice, with the same weights both times.
Before every pass, the input block's output is added back, so the loop keeps its starting point.
Eight output layers turn the final state into the next token.
Here is NVIDIA's own drawing. The input block, I, makes the starting state.
Each loop adds that input back in and runs the shared block R again, from loop one to loop k.

scenes.title: Where the keys and values go

left.title: Per loop cache
items: Every pass keeps its own keys and values
Memory grows with the loop count
left.say: By default, every pass keeps its own keys and values, so the cache grows with each loop.

right.title: Last loop cache
items: One cache per recurrent attention layer
Each pass overwrites the one before
Stays at the one loop size
right.say: In last loop mode, each pass overwrites the one before. The cache stays at the one loop size, whatever the loop count.

scenes.title: Compute per token, by loop count
scenes.say: The parameters never change. The work per token does: each extra pass adds about one point eight billion multiply adds.

scenes.title: SWE-bench Verified, by loop count
scenes.say: Most of the reported gain comes from the second pass. A fourth adds a little on agent tasks, and nothing on recall.

scenes.text: Looping buys more thinking per token, not more facts: the second pass lifts reasoning scores while knowledge stays flat.
scenes.say: Looping buys more thinking per token, not more facts. Reasoning scores rise, and the knowledge score stays flat.

recap: One shared block, run up to four times
Parameters fixed, compute grows per pass
Last loop cache keeps memory flat
scenes.say: One shared block, run up to four times. Fixed parameters, growing compute, and a cache mode that keeps memory flat.
